articleTitle: Microsoft’s President Calls for ‘Emergency Brakes’ on AI, Says It Is Less Regulated than Milk

sources.title: AI less regulated than milk, Microsoft president says in warning over safety - The Guardian
‘AI is less regulated than milk’: Why Microsoft president wants tougher safety rules | Trending

claims.claim: Microsoft’s president Brad Smith has publicly compared the regulatory oversight of artificial intelligence to that of grocery‑store milk.
claims.bestSource: Microsoft president Brad Smith says AI is less regulated than milk - Cryptopolitan
claims.evidence: Brad Smith, Microsoft’s president, has told the BBC that AI is currently working with fewer safety rules than commodities like milk or washing machines, and this should push governments, with the UK out front, to write binding controls, including kill switches and mandatory reporting when AI agents misbehave. Microsoft president Brad Smith believes they are not, arguing that everyday products such as milk and washing machines face stricter safety requirements than AI systems.
